admission.justification: Combining immutable Lean/DAG models, closed-world parsing, provenance-preserving stub emission, stage-map validation and atomic CLI emission guarantees reproducible, zero-partial-write Stage 00 skeleton and DAG artifacts without executing Lean.

guarantee: Invoking rh-extract against read-only upstream checkouts validates the 8-stage condensed map, parses all mapped Lean 4 files under a closed-world grammar, and atomically emits byte-identical provenance-preserving skeleton files and an import-only DAG without executing Lean or leaving partial writes on error.
title: Phase 1 deterministic Lean 4 extractor, stage map and Stage 00 skeleton pipeline
